electric.method: PSE&G average price 25.03 cents/kWh (EIA-861 2025, revenue / sales, residential, bundled service (Part A)) x 259 kWh/month (3112 kWh/year): RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast (Middle Atlantic + New England) apartments in 5+ unit buildings whose main heat is not electric, 1 bedroom, weighted mean, n=165. Cross-check: published Table CE2.2 gives 4,650 kWh/year for all such apartments, electric heat included. Territory: point-in-polygon on HIFLD/ORNL Electric Retail Service Territories (2022 vintage), with documented overrides.

if_heat_is_electric_add.note: RECS 2020 space-heating kWh in electrically heated Northeast apartments (5+ units), n=119; applies only if the tenant pays for electric heat. Not added to the amount.

cooking_only.method: PSE&G (gas), RSG Residential Service: fixed $9.99 plus $1.1104 per therm, both derived from the winter bill table (25 therms $37.75, 50 therms $65.51), supply included (rates in effect 2026-06-01 (winter bill table)); assumed cooking use 1.6 therms/month (RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast apartments in 5+ unit buildings with gas cooking, n=108). Taxes not included.

cooking_plus_heat.method: cooking-only figure ($12) + NJ average residential gas price $1.369/therm (EIA 2025 annual, $14.21/Mcf at 1038 Btu per cubic foot) x 11.7 therms/month of space heating (annual use / 12; RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast apartments in 5+ unit buildings heated with gas, n=124). An annual average: winter bills are several times higher and summer bills lower. Water heating is not included.

if_gas_water_heater_add.note: only if the unit has its own gas water heater; RECS 2020, n=128. Not added to the amount.

gas.method: PSE&G (gas), RSG Residential Service: fixed $9.99 plus $1.1104 per therm, both derived from the winter bill table (25 therms $37.75, 50 therms $65.51), supply included (rates in effect 2026-06-01 (winter bill table)); assumed cooking use 1.4 therms/month (RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast apartments in 5+ unit buildings with gas cooking, n=13). Taxes not included.

internet.method: flat figure, the same for every address: Verizon Fios 500 Mbps (the middle of five tiers: 300 Mbps, 500 Mbps, 1 Gig, 2 Gig, 5 Gig), published monthly price before the $10 Auto Pay and paper-free discount; the page says pricing includes taxes, fees and router. Not address-specific; availability at the address was not checked.
